query_sanitization: None. Exact workbook string passed to canonical BagOfWordsQueryGenerator; analyzer tokenization, English stopword removal, and Porter stemming only.
indexed_content: Exact chunk text only; canonical stringified corpus ID is a document identifier, not a retrieval term. No ref or source metadata.

bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(42), reset for each scope; batches of 100

relevance_interpretation: Binary relevance relative to declared expert gold judgments. Unannotated retrieved text is not necessarily semantically irrelevant.
parameter_selection: Fixed a priori; no evaluation-driven tuning.
existing_corpus_artifacts: Corpus retained without filtering or deduplication; gold annotations follow frozen_eval_v2 (Oct9 update).
java_version:
openjdk version "21.0.8" 2025-07-15 LTS
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Zulu21.44+17-CA (build 21.0.8+9-LTS)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Zulu21.44+17-CA (build 21.0.8+9-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)
anserini_manifest:
Manifest-Version: 1.0
Created-By: Maven JAR Plugin 3.3.0
Build-Jdk-Spec: 21
Multi-Release: true

index_configuration.stopwords: Anserini built-in default English stop set

retrieval_api: pyserini.pyclass.autoclass(io.anserini.search.SimpleSearcher); canonical Java implementation used by LuceneSearcher
tie_breaking: Canonical Anserini SimpleSearcher score order with document-ID tie breaking; no Python reordering.
short_run_policy: Return up to 1000 matching documents; do not fabricate or pad zero-score documents. Precision denominator remains k.
aggregation: Unweighted macro mean over questions; per-query F1 is averaged, not F1 of macro precision/recall.

reproducibility_check.result: byte-identical run, per-query metrics, aggregates, and bootstrap intervals

retrieval_provenance: Rankings from the local canonical BM25 run; package evaluation independently recomputed against its JSON dataset.
